messages:
morgan: FYI saw a big tail on tiny RPCs during the midday spike, ~2.6x p99. quick flame: parse/tokenize hot.

alex: confirming. small payloads (<200B) spend most cycles in host_proxy::parse_frame and tokenizer::tokenize_utf8.

Priya: is kv cache involved or pure parse cost?

morgan: hotspots: parse_frame 45%, tokenize_utf8 22%, grpc_writev_coalesce 10%, kvcache::lookup 8%, hpack_decode 6%.

jamal: kvcache misses are more frequent because header metadata order differs; keys not normalized so misses spike on small requests.

alex: repro loop attached, reproduces on canary.

sam: profiler shows many 1-2ms parse_frame spikes with std::string allocs inside. lots of tiny heap allocs.

Priya: two tracks: zero-copy proto parsing to avoid copies, and batching/coalesce small concurrent requests pre-tokenize.

morgan: zero-copy reduced parse CPU ~35% in microbench but increased kvcache misses due to ephemeral slices.

jamal: need canonical header-hash emitter that normalizes order before caching. cheap stable hash should fix collision surface.

alex: also noticed kernel selector picks int8 path for short sequences; int8 has setup overhead that kills short requests. need to amortize setup in selector: score = est_latency + setup_penalty / max(1, expected_tokens).

Priya: batching heuristic: coalesce tiny requests within 1ms window and run single tokenizer, but cap max wait to avoid latency regressions.

morgan: implemented canonical-hash + header cache locally: kvcache hit 72%->88%, parse_frame down 48%, p99 from 23ms->8.5ms for spike scen.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: proxy/canary-2026-03-21-15:10 (morgan)

alex: increased writev coalesce to 500us reduces syscalls ~40%, median +0.3ms but much smoother tail.

sam: sounds like acceptable trade.

jamal: I'll add telemetry for canonical-hash collisions and cache evictions.

Action items:
- alex: PR for kernel-selector amortization + unit test
- jamal: PR for canonical header-hash + header cache + telemetry
- morgan: publish microbench flames and update perf runbook
- Priya: run KV regression bench on Dedicated configs

morgan: targeting PRs today, roll to 100% tomorrow if canary stable. will paste PRs here and tag eng-sre for soak. :thumbsup:
